text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert: CANARY_FAIL_APAC - 3/5 probes failing in apac-canary-wave-7. Pager: @sam (oncall) :rotating_light:

pagerduty: Incident triggered: https://pagerduty.example/PD12345 - Escalation policy: canary-synths

sam (oncall): acked the page. I'm looking. any recent deploys to apac regions?

nina (eng-runtime): I saw a small rollout ~40m ago that changed token refresh library for probes. didnt think it would touch canaries but tagging.

maria (support): any customer reports yet? support dashboard shows no errors for production traffic, looks limited to synthetics currently.

alex (observability): digging metrics - probe failures are 502/503 from auth-service-eu->apac-proxy. snippet:

```
2026-03-14T02:00:11Z canary apac-wave-7 probe_id=wu12 status=503 upstream="auth-service" msg="token refresh failed: 401 response from auth"
2026-03-14T02:00:12Z canary apac-wave-7 probe_id=wu13 status=503 upstream="auth-service" msg="token refresh failed: 401 response from auth"
```

sam (oncall): 401 -> maybe token rotation issue. @raj can you check KMS/rotation and recent creds?

raj (platform): looking. I see a KMS rotation job ran 30m ago for a short-lived credential used by probe runner. rotation completed but service account policy for the probe runner was missing the new key. rolling back rotation now.

nina (eng-runtime): if it's credential mismatch that would explain 401 -> auth -> 503. we can pause the apac canary wave to avoid repeated paging and reduce noise. recommended: flip feature flag for canary-wave-7 to disabled and then re-run after fix.

sam (oncall): doing that now.

incident-bot: canary-wave-7 flag toggled to OFF by sam (oncall) at 2026-03-14T02:03:45Z :white_check_mark:

sam (oncall): paused canary, paging noise should stop. still want a postmortem. opening incident ticket.

pagerduty: Note: incident acknowledged by sam (oncall). Next escalation at 02:20 unless resolved.

raj (platform): rollback of key rotation initiated. I can confirm probe runner started using the previous key again at 02:05:12Z.

alex (observability): re-checking probe responses... failures dropping off, current failures 0/5 for apac-wave-7. latency for probe run normalizing.

maria (support): no customer-facing errors observed, will send a short status to support channel summarizing: "Synthetic checks for APAC canaries failed briefly due to credential rotation; no production traffic errors detected; canary paused and rotation rolled back."

sam (oncall): nice. I'm going to keep the canary paused until we validate a fix. Nina, can you prepare a patch to make the probe runner resilient to rotation? maybe retry credential fetch and fallback to cached token for 5m.

nina (eng-runtime): yep. I can push a short-lived hotfix to the probe runner: add exponential retry and 5m cached token fallback. plan to ship to canary runners only, test, then re-enable. ETA 45m.

sam (oncall): assignable follow-ups:
- raj: document rotation runbook so we don't break probe permissions (owner: raj)
- nina: patch probe runner for token fallback (owner: nina)
- alex: add alert suppression rule when canary flag manually toggled (owner: alex)
- maria: customer comms draft (owner: maria)

pagerduty: Incident update: Root cause suspected - KMS rotation changed active key, probe runner lacked permission for new key leading to 401s -> probe failures. Impact: synthetic checks only, no known user impact.

sam (oncall): I'm going to hand off on-call in 20 minutes to @jordan. leaving notes in the incident ticket.

incident-bot: @jordan on-call handoff in 15 minutes.

raj (platform): doing a follow-up permission check now to ensure future rotations update probe runner policy automatically. Will add an automated verification step to rotation pipeline.

nina (eng-runtime): pushed PR for probe runner resilience: https://git.internal/prs/987 - includes tests and canary-only rollout.

sam (oncall): PR looks good, let's merge and roll to probe fleet once CI green. hold on re-enabling the wave until after we validate.

alex (observability): CI green for PR. Rolling to probe runners in staging now. will monitor for auth errors.

maria (support): sent status update to customers affected by synthetic monitoring (internal ops): "Brief interruption to synthetic canaries in APAC due to credential rotation; mitigated and canaries paused; no production errors observed. We will follow up after root cause analysis."

sam (oncall): final checkpoint: canaries paused, rotation rolled back, fix in progress. leaving this as INCIDENT-TICKET-2026-03-14-APAC-CANARY. handing off to jordan for overnight watch.

pagerduty: Incident resolved (monitoring). Please follow up with RCA in 72 hours.

sam (oncall): ack. closing channel for urgent noise. thanks everyone :heart:
